versions.changelog:
- Revised documentation in README.md and SKILL.md for clarity and formatting.
- Removed skill-card.md to streamline project files.
- No functional changes; this release focuses on documentation updates.

- Initial release of the recover skill.
- Scans for orphaned worktrees, stale branches, and partial work left after crashes or abandoned sessions.
- Read-only by default: reports findings and requires explicit user approval before any cleanup.
- Identifies orphaned worktrees, classifies stale branches, and checks for prunable git state.
- Proposes safe cleanup actions, preserving unmerged commits and changes where possible.
